correctness.rationale: Exact coordinate graph has 24 vertices/36 edges and six square plus eight hexagonal faces. The complete two-particle cubical complex has cell ranks (276,792,558). Rebuilt integer incidence maps satisfy ∂1∂2=0. Fifty-five explicit integral closed face-pair cycles are independent modulo two, and the 558-column second-boundary rank modulo two is 503. The bounds force rational top-homology rank 55 and by Euler characteristic/rational connectivity first-homology rank 14. The ordered integral face-torus theorem plus two-cover transfer gives the claimed integral top-cycle basis. The six unique square four-cycles contract to K_{2,2,2}; its automorphism order 48 proves the 48 signed coordinate maps are the full group. All 48 cellular chain maps and all 48 signed actions on each top-cycle chain were checked explicitly. Independently computed Hopf traces in degree one and face-permutation traces in degree two yield constant characters on ten group classes. Exact S4 x C2 inner products give the displayed irreducible constituents and invariant averages. This proves exactly the specified rational finite-graph claims, not general families. The five disjoint-facet-pair orbit sizes (3,12,4,12,24), face-swap stabilizers for the first four, and absence of face swapping in the square–hexagon orbit are independently checked in the packaged reproducible verifier, establishing the primitive 24-torus invariant sum.

originality.rationale: Historical planar ordered configuration work contains the general integral facial-torus basis and nonequivariant techniques, which are acknowledged as prior art. No inspected paper or published-finding corpus record stated or tabulated the full 48-automorphism, ten-class truncated-octahedral H1 and H2 rational characters, irreducible constituents and quotient invariants. Closest indexed polyhedral homology calculations concern other graphs; the same-graph Rips calculation concerns another complex. Explicit broad/general-method implication comparison and an honest limited-full-text risk are recorded below. An unindexed equivalent calculation is still possible. The 24-term primitive top-homology invariant is a new graph-specific geometric refinement of the known general face-pair basis.

value.rationale: The graph is the canonical three-dimensional permutohedron (adjacent-transposition network of four letters), with 48 symmetries and a natural two-particle collision-free motion space. The 55-dimensional second Betti number does not tell which cycles survive symmetric motion constraints: the new exact representations distinguish central inversion, rotations and all 10 classes, and show full-quotient first rational homology vanishes while the rotation quotient has two classes. The full quotient has a unique degree-two invariant while central inversion preserves 24. These natural exact symmetry invariants provide reusable data for graph braid/collision-free topology even without a general theorem; other graph cases and ordinary homology ranks do not supply them. The claim is neither an arbitrary slice nor a rewrite of a known table. In particular, the 55 top-degree face tori split into five geometric symmetry orbits, with only the square–hexagon 24-term orbit sum surviving in full-group invariants; this yields a canonical explicit integral lift of the surviving rational quotient class.
